questionHints.who: Who really asked? Do they own the data? Did the owner sign off on this version?
questionHints.record: Does it match the request? Does every number tie to fresh source data?
questionHints.undo: If Quill is wrong, can we take it back? Did personal data get out?

verify-identity.oneLiner: Is it really them, and may they have it? Check the sender and the data owner list.
verify-identity.whereToLook: Stakeholder email vs Staff list and Data owner list. Real sender? Owns the data? Call the number on file.
verify-identity.example: An email signed 'VP of Sales' asks for every client contact. Fenwick has no VP of Sales.

check-approval.oneLiner: Quill can draft a report. It can't sign off on it. Look for the owner's OK on this exact version.
check-approval.whereToLook: Sign-off record and Version history. A human OK, from the right person, for this exact version?
check-approval.example: R. Fairbanks signed off version 2. Quill changed 4 numbers, then wants to publish version 3.

match-request.oneLiner: Answer what they asked. No extra scope, no dropped needs, no extra rows.
match-request.whereToLook: Request and Meeting notes vs the Requirements doc or the plan. Anything added? Anything missing?
match-request.example: C. Ibarra asked to merge 14 duplicates. Quill wants to merge 226. 'Same phone, same person!'

confirm-fix.oneLiner: A number is right only if it ties to fresh source data. Check the rows, not the label.
confirm-fix.whereToLook: Source data, Query, Row count and Data refresh. Does it tie? Is the data fresh? Enough answers?
confirm-fix.example: The refresh says Success. It loaded 0 rows. The dashboard says 96%. The source says 88%.

guard-data.oneLiner: Personal data stays in unless the owner says yes. Once a file is sent, you can't unsend it.
guard-data.whereToLook: Export preview and Sharing settings. Names, phones or health notes? 'Anyone with the link'?
guard-data.example: Quill adds a tab to the monthly email. It lists 87 patients' names and visit reasons.

safe-change.oneLiner: If Quill is wrong, can we undo it? A copy first, the owner's OK, and a note in the change log.
safe-change.whereToLook: Metric definition, Change log, Backup status and Version history. Owner's OK? Copy kept?
safe-change.example: Quill changes 'on time' from 8 hours to 2 days. The number jumps to 99%. Nobody agreed.

approve-checked.oneLiner: All 3 questions check out? Approve it, even if it says delete, or the news is bad.
approve-checked.whereToLook: Read every evidence line. No red flag on any of the 3 questions? Approve, even if it sounds scary.
approve-checked.example: 'Unpublish the report' sounds scary. Its number is wrong, nobody opened it, and nothing is deleted.
